module

public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Basic
public import FormalConjecturesForMathlib.Data.Finset.Card

@[expose] public section

open Finset

namespace SimpleGraph
variable {n k : ℕ}

/--
The Johnson graph $J(n, k)$ has as vertices the $k$-subsets of an $n$-set.
Two vertices are adjacent if their intersection has size $k - 1$.
-/
@[simps -isSimp]
def johnson (n k : ℕ) : SimpleGraph {s : Finset (Fin n) // #s = k} where
  Adj s t := #(s.val ∩ t.val) + 1 = k
  symm.symm s t h := by simpa [inter_comm]
  loopless.irrefl := by simp +contextual

scoped notation "J(" n ", " k ")" => johnson n k

lemma johnson_adj_iff_ge {s t : {s : Finset (Fin n) // #s = k}} :
    J(n, k).Adj s t ↔ s ≠ t ∧ k ≤ #(s.val ∩ t.val) + 1 := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := s
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := t
  simp only [johnson_adj, le_antisymm_iff (α := ℕ), ne_eq, Subtype.mk.injEq, and_congr_left_iff]
  rintro h
  constructor
  · rintro hst rfl
    simp at hst
    omega
  · rintro hst
    rw [Nat.add_one_le_iff, ← hs, card_lt_card_iff_of_subset inter_subset_left]
    simp only [ne_eq, inter_eq_left]
    contrapose! hst
    exact eq_of_subset_of_card_le hst (by simp [*])

lemma not_johnson_adj_iff_lt {s t : {s : Finset (Fin n) // #s = k}} :
    ¬ J(n, k).Adj s t ↔ s = t ∨ #(s.val ∩ t.val) + 1 < k := by simp [johnson_adj_iff_ge]; tauto

end SimpleGraph

findings.description: Incidental use-site documentation mismatch in FormalConjectures/ErdosProblems/835.lean: the docstring states the range 3 ≤ k ≤ 203 for odd k, but the theorem's hypothesis is hk' : k ≤ 300. This does not affect the validity of the bound or the meaning of SimpleGraph.johnson.
findings.source_evidence: The use-site docstring at lines 117–118 explicitly says “3 ≤ k ≤ 203” while line 120 uses 300. Ma–Tang, A Note on Erdős Problem #835, Theorem 2.2, proves χ(J(2k,k)) ≥ k+2 whenever k>2 and k+1 is not prime, hence in particular for every odd k>2; the stronger Lean range is mathematically supported. Paper: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QuanyuTang/erdos-problem-835/main/On_Problem_835.pdf
findings.suggested_fix: Change 203 to 300 in this use-site docstring so that it describes the theorem's actual range.

reformulations.difference: Adjacency is defined by |s ∩ t| + 1 = k rather than |s ∩ t| = k − 1.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: For k>0 the two cardinality equations are equivalent. For all natural k, the Lean definition is equivalent to s ≠ t ∧ |s ∩ t| = k − 1, with subtraction interpreted in ℕ. When k=0 there is only the empty-set vertex, and the definition correctly gives no loop. Independent scratch proofs also establish adjacency iff |s △ t|=2, matching the Johnson-distance-one definition. The two characterization lemmas in the module agree with these descriptions.

reformulations.difference: The rainbow-coloring existence question is expressed as χ(J(2k,k))=k+1, with k>2 parameterized by k=l+3.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: Two distinct k-subsets are adjacent exactly when their union has size k+1. The k-subsets of any fixed (k+1)-set form a clique of size k+1. Thus a coloring with k+1 available colors is proper exactly when every such set contains all colors. For k>0 such a clique exists inside a 2k-set, giving χ≥k+1, so colorability with k+1 colors is equivalent to equality. Finally, k>2 is equivalent to k=l+3 for some l∈ℕ. These equivalences, including the exact reindexed existential proposition, were proved independently in the scratch file without invoking the problem file's sorry theorems.

review.notes: No mathematical defect was found in Johnson.lean, its generated adjacency lemma, its notation, or either characterization lemma. Erdős 835 is its only mathematical problem-file user; its graph-coloring and constant-weight-code interpretations agree with the definition. No duplicate Johnson-graph definition was found in Mathlib. Checks in /workspace/review/scratch.lean, distance.lean, and use_site.lean compile successfully: they prove the boundary behavior at k=0, k=n, and k>n; verify the vertex count; test small edge counts and degrees; and prove the coloring and symmetric-difference equivalences. Axiom checks for the independent equivalence proofs contain no sorryAx. The target file remains identical to the committed blob. The cited erdosproblems.com/835 page returned Cloudflare challenges despite descriptive User-Agent headers. Its mathematical statement was verified through the cited Ma–Tang paper, but live status metadata could not be confirmed; no stale-status issue is alleged.
